1 | /**
2 |  * review.ts — Human Review Interface (Task 25).
3 |  *
4 |  * Provides the `applyFinding` and `rejectFinding` functions that implement
5 |  * the accept / accept-with-edit / reject decision loop.
6 |  *
7 |  * Contract:
8 |  *  - `applyFinding(finding, { editedValue: null })` → attempts to write the
9 |  *    original suggestion to GitLab.
10 |  *    - If the write succeeds (adapter returns written:true): logs outcome = 'accepted'.
11 |  *    - If the write fails  (adapter returns written:false): logs outcome = 'failed'.
12 |  *  - `applyFinding(finding, { editedValue: '...' })` → attempts to write the
13 |  *    edited value to GitLab.
14 |  *    - If the write succeeds: logs outcome = 'edited'.
15 |  *    - If the write fails:    logs outcome = 'failed'.
16 |  *  - For non-writable findings (advisory-only or report-only), the user intent
17 |  *    ('accepted' / 'edited') is logged directly because no write is attempted.
18 |  *  - `rejectFinding(finding)` → does NOT write to GitLab; logs outcome = 'rejected'.
19 |  *  - Skip is NOT handled here — skip is neutral and must not be logged.
20 |  *
21 |  * Finding types accepted:
22 |  *  - AgentFinding (AC, AM, ST, COV agents) — written via the GitLab writer adapter.
23 |  *  - DependencyFinding (DEP agent) — report-only: the GitLab API has no
24 |  *    issue-links endpoint wired yet, so `gitlabWriteCalled` is always false
25 |  *    for dependency findings.  See SKILL.md §Phase 3 note on Task 22.
26 |  *
27 |  * Action-specific write behaviour:
28 |  *  - 'draft_ac'         — appends the AC text to the issue description.
29 |  *  - 'state_transition' — the suggested state must be applied via a scoped label
30 |  *                         swap; the adapter receives the target state name.
31 |  *  - 'missing_coverage' — report-only advisory; never written to GitLab.
32 |  *  - 'rewrite_desc'     — replaces the description once the drafter has written it.
33 |  *
34 |  * Conflict detection:
35 |  *  When `applyFinding` is called for an issue that already has a pending
36 |  *  decision in the current session (tracked in memory), it logs a warning but
37 |  *  still proceeds. For the full conflict-surfacing UX the SKILL.md runtime
38 |  *  instructions direct Bob to detect multiple findings on the same issue and
39 |  *  present them to the user before calling these functions.
40 |  *
41 |  * Writer:
42 |  *  The module uses `defaultWriterAdapter` by default. Pass an explicit adapter
43 |  *  (e.g. the stub) in tests to avoid live GitLab calls.
44 |  */
45 | 
46 | import type { AgentFinding, AnyFinding, DependencyFinding, ReviewOptions, ReviewResult, TelemetryEntry } from '../models';
47 | import type { GitLabWriterAdapter } from './gitlab-writer-adapter';
48 | import { defaultWriterAdapter } from './gitlab-writer-adapter';
49 | import { appendTelemetry } from './telemetry';
50 | 
51 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
52 | // In-session conflict tracking
53 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
54 | 
55 | /** Tracks which issue IIDs have already had a decision applied in this session. */
56 | const _appliedInSession = new Set<number>();
57 | 
58 | /** Reset the session tracker — used in tests to isolate runs. */
59 | export function _resetSessionTracker(): void {
60 |   _appliedInSession.clear();
61 | }
62 | 
63 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
64 | // Helpers
65 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
66 | 
67 | /** Type guard — true when the finding is a DependencyFinding. */
68 | function isDependencyFinding(f: AnyFinding): f is DependencyFinding {
69 |   return (f as DependencyFinding).sourceIid !== undefined;
70 | }
71 | 
72 | /**
73 |  * Derive the set of fields that were modified from the finding action.
74 |  * Used for telemetry when the user edits the suggestion.
75 |  */
76 | function editedFieldsFor(finding: AnyFinding): string[] {
77 |   if (isDependencyFinding(finding)) return [];
78 |   switch ((finding as AgentFinding).action) {
79 |     case 'draft_ac':         return ['description'];
80 |     case 'rewrite_desc':     return ['description'];
81 |     case 'state_transition': return ['state'];
82 |     case 'missing_coverage': return [];
83 |     default:                 return [];
84 |   }
85 | }
86 | 
87 | /**
88 |  * Returns true when the finding's action allows a write to GitLab.
89 |  * Report-only findings ('missing_coverage') and
90 |  * dependency findings (no links API yet) must never be written.
91 |  */
92 | function isWritable(finding: AnyFinding): boolean {
93 |   if (isDependencyFinding(finding)) return false;
94 |   const action = (finding as AgentFinding).action;
95 |   return action === 'draft_ac' || action === 'rewrite_desc' || action === 'state_transition';
96 | }
97 | 
98 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
99 | // applyFinding
100 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
101 | 
102 | /**
103 |  * Apply an agent finding — with or without an edit — and log the outcome.
104 |  *
105 |  * Accepts both AgentFinding and DependencyFinding (AnyFinding).
106 |  * Dependency findings and advisory-only findings are logged but NOT written
107 |  * to GitLab (see module-level contract above).
108 |  *
109 |  * @param finding   The original agent finding to act on.
110 |  * @param options   `editedValue` is null for a straight accept; a non-null
111 |  *                  string means the user provided an edited value.
112 |  * @param adapter   GitLab writer adapter (defaults to defaultWriterAdapter).
113 |  */
114 | export async function applyFinding(
115 |   finding: AnyFinding,
116 |   options: ReviewOptions,
117 |   adapter: GitLabWriterAdapter = defaultWriterAdapter
118 | ): Promise<ReviewResult> {
119 |   // Agents hand over a brief, not prose. If the brief is still attached the drafter
120 |   // never ran and suggestedValue is a placeholder; writing it would put filler on the
121 |   // issue and log it as a success. An edited value means a human supplied the text.
122 |   if (
123 |     !isDependencyFinding(finding) &&
124 |     (finding as AgentFinding).draft &&
125 |     options.editedValue === null
126 |   ) {
127 |     const iid = (finding as AgentFinding).issueIid;
128 |     throw new Error(
129 |       `Finding for issue #${iid} has not been drafted. Replace suggestedValue with the ` +
130 |         `drafted text and clear the draft field before applying.`
131 |     );
132 |   }
133 | 
134 |   // User's intent — resolved against writeResult.written below for writable findings.
135 |   const userIntent: 'accepted' | 'edited' =
136 |     options.editedValue !== null ? 'edited' : 'accepted';
137 | 
138 |   // Resolve the issue IID for conflict tracking and telemetry
139 |   const issueIid = isDependencyFinding(finding)
140 |     ? finding.sourceIid
141 |     : (finding as AgentFinding).issueIid;
142 | 
143 |   // Conflict detection (in-session)
144 |   if (_appliedInSession.has(issueIid)) {
145 |     process.stderr.write(
146 |       `[sdlc-harness] Warning: a decision was already applied to issue #${issueIid} this session.\n`
147 |     );
148 |   }
149 | 
150 |   // Attempt the write only for writable actions; reconcile outcome against the result.
151 |   let gitlabWriteCalled = false;
152 |   let writtenValue: string | undefined;
153 |   let outcome: 'accepted' | 'edited' | 'failed';
154 | 
155 |   if (isWritable(finding)) {
156 |     const valueToWrite =
157 |       options.editedValue ?? (finding as AgentFinding).suggestedValue;
158 |     const writeResult = await adapter.applyFindingToGitLab(
159 |       finding as AgentFinding,
160 |       valueToWrite
161 |     );
162 |     gitlabWriteCalled = writeResult.written;
163 |     if (writeResult.written) {
164 |       // Write reached GitLab — honour the user's intent.
165 |       outcome = userIntent;
166 |       writtenValue = writeResult.value;
167 |     } else {
168 |       // Write did NOT reach GitLab — record as 'failed' so the acceptance-rate
169 |       // denominator is not inflated by writes that never happened.
170 |       outcome = 'failed';
171 |     }
172 |   } else {
173 |     // Non-writable findings (advisory / report-only / dependency): no write is
174 |     // attempted, so the user's intent is the outcome directly.
175 |     outcome = userIntent;
176 |   }
177 | 
178 |   _appliedInSession.add(issueIid);
179 | 
180 |   // Build telemetry entry — derive editedFields from the finding action.
181 |   const agentTag = isDependencyFinding(finding) ? finding.agent : (finding as AgentFinding).agent;
182 |   const action   = isDependencyFinding(finding)
183 |     ? 'dependency_link'
184 |     : (finding as AgentFinding).action;
185 | 
186 |   const telemetryEntry: TelemetryEntry = {
187 |     timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
188 |     agent: agentTag,
189 |     issueIid,
190 |     action,
191 |     outcome,
192 |     // editedFields is meaningful only when the write actually landed.
193 |     editedFields: outcome === 'edited' ? editedFieldsFor(finding) : [],
194 |   };
195 | 
196 |   await appendTelemetry(telemetryEntry);
197 | 
198 |   return {
199 |     gitlabWriteCalled,
200 |     writtenValue,
201 |     telemetryEntry,
202 |   };
203 | }
204 | 
205 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
206 | // rejectFinding
207 | // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
208 | 
209 | /**
210 |  * Reject an agent finding — does NOT write to GitLab, logs the rejection.
211 |  *
212 |  * @param finding   The finding to reject (AgentFinding or DependencyFinding).
213 |  */
214 | export async function rejectFinding(
215 |   finding: AnyFinding
216 | ): Promise<ReviewResult> {
217 |   const issueIid = isDependencyFinding(finding)
218 |     ? finding.sourceIid
219 |     : (finding as AgentFinding).issueIid;
220 |   const agentTag = isDependencyFinding(finding) ? finding.agent : (finding as AgentFinding).agent;
221 |   const action   = isDependencyFinding(finding)
222 |     ? 'dependency_link'
223 |     : (finding as AgentFinding).action;
224 | 
225 |   const telemetryEntry: TelemetryEntry = {
226 |     timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
227 |     agent: agentTag,
228 |     issueIid,
229 |     action,
230 |     outcome: 'rejected',
231 |     editedFields: [],
232 |   };
233 | 
234 |   await appendTelemetry(telemetryEntry);
235 | 
236 |   return {
237 |     gitlabWriteCalled: false,
238 |     telemetryEntry,
239 |   };
240 | }
